q.en: Which sensory modality is the ONLY one that reaches the cerebral cortex directly without first relaying in the thalamus?
q.uz: Qaysi sezgi turi talamusda almashinmasdan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bosh miya po'stlog'iga yetib boradigan YAGONA sezgidir?

options.en: Olfaction (smell)
options.uz: Hid bilish sezgisi

options.en: Vision (retinal sight)
options.uz: Ko'rish (retinal) sezgisi

options.en: Audition (cochlear hearing)
options.uz: Eshitish (koxlear) sezgisi

options.en: Gustation (visceral taste)
options.uz: Ta'm bilish (gustator) sezgisi

why.en: Every sensory pathway to the neocortex relays in the thalamus (VPL/VPM for somatosensory, VPMpc for taste, LGN for vision, MGN for hearing) except olfaction, which projects directly from the olfactory bulb to the primary olfactory (piriform) cortex.
why.uz: Po'stloqqa boruvchi barcha sezgi yo'llari talamusda almashinadi (tana va yuz sezgisi uchun VPL/VPM, ta'm uchun VPMpc, ko'rish uchun LGN, eshitish uchun MGN); faqat hid bilish talamusni chetlab o'tib, hidlov piyozchasidan bevosita noksimon (piriform) po'stloqqa boradi.

q.en: Which Y-shaped white-matter sheet inside the thalamus divides it into anterior, medial, and lateral nuclear groups and houses the intralaminar nuclei?
q.uz: Talamus ichidagi qaysi Y-shaklli oq modda qatlami uni oldingi, medial va lateral yadro guruhlariga ajratadi hamda o'z ichida intralaminar yadrolarni saqlaydi?

options.en: Internal medullary lamina
options.uz: Ichki medullyar plastinka (lamina medullaris interna)

options.en: External medullary lamina
options.uz: Tashqi medullyar plastinka (lamina medullaris externa)

options.en: Lamina terminalis of the third ventricle
options.uz: Uchinchi qorinchaning oxirgi plastinkasi (lamina terminalis)

options.en: Stria medullaris thalami
options.uz: Talamusning miya chizig'i (stria medullaris thalami)

why.en: On the thalamic nuclei map (plate T2) and coronal cut (T1), the Y-shaped internal medullary lamina splits the thalamus into the anterior group (in the fork), medial group (MD), and lateral group, while enclosing the intralaminar nuclei (centromedian CM and parafascicular Pf).
why.uz: T1 va T2 plastinkalarida ko'ringanidek, Y-shaklli ichki medullyar plastinka talamusni oldingi (ayri ichida), medial (MD) va lateral yadro guruhlariga bo'ladi; intralaminar yadrolar (CM, Pf) esa aynan shu plastinka ichida joylashgan.

q.en: Which two thalamic relay nuclei receive somatosensory input from the contralateral body (medial lemniscus and spinothalamic tract) and from the face (trigeminal lemniscus), respectively?
q.uz: Talamusning qaysi ikki bo'g'in yadrosi mos ravishda qarama-qarshi tanadan (medial lemnisk va spinotalamik trakt) hamda yuzdan (trigeminal lemnisk) somatosensor signallarni qabul qiladi?

options.en: Ventral posterolateral (VPL) and ventral posteromedial (VPM) nuclei
options.uz: Ventral orqa-lateral (VPL) va ventral orqa-medial (VPM) yadrolar

options.en: Ventral anterior (VA) and ventral lateral (VL) motor relay nuclei
options.uz: Ventral oldingi (VA) va ventral lateral (VL) harakat yadrolari

options.en: Lateral geniculate (LGN) and medial geniculate (MGN) relay nuclei
options.uz: Lateral tizzasimon (LGN) va medial tizzasimon (MGN) yadrolar

options.en: Anterior nuclear group (AV/AM) and mediodorsal (MD) association nucleus
options.uz: Oldingi yadrolar guruhi (AV/AM) va mediodorsal (MD) assotsiativ yadro

why.en: VPL (Limbs/body, lateral) receives the medial lemniscus and spinothalamic tract; VPM (Mouth/face, medial) receives the trigeminal lemniscus (and taste in VPMpc). Both project through the posterior limb of the internal capsule to the postcentral gyrus (S1).
why.uz: VPL (lateralda — tana va oyoq-qo'llar) medial lemnisk va spinotalamik traktni qabul qiladi; VPM (medialda — yuz va og'iz) esa trigeminal lemniskni (va VPMpc qismida ta'mni) qabul qiladi. Ikkalasi ichki kapsula orqa oyog'i orqali orqa markaziy pushtaga (S1) uzatadi.

q.en: Which two nuclei make up the metathalamus under the pulvinar, and what sensory pathways do they relay?
q.uz: Pulvinar ostidagi metatalamusni qaysi ikki yadro tashkil etadi va ular qaysi sezgi yo'llarini uzatadi?

options.en: Lateral geniculate (vision to V1) and medial geniculate (hearing to A1)
options.uz: Lateral tizzasimon (ko'rishni V1 ga) va medial tizzasimon (eshitishni A1 ga)

options.en: Habenular nuclei (limbic aversion) and pineal body (circadian melatonin)
options.uz: Habenula yadrolari (limbik aloqa) va epifiz bezi (sirkad melatonin ajratish)

options.en: Subthalamic nucleus (motor gating) and zona incerta (sensory modulation)
options.uz: Subtalamik yadro (harakat boshqaruvi) va zona incerta (sezgi modulyatsiyasi)

options.en: Ventral posterolateral (body touch) and ventral posteromedial (facial pain)
options.uz: Ventral orqa-lateral (tana sezgisi) va ventral orqa-medial (yuz sezgisi)

why.en: On plates T2 and O3, the metathalamus sits beneath the overhanging pulvinar: the six-layered lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) relays retinal input via the optic radiation to V1 (BA17), while the medial geniculate body (MGN) relays auditory input from the inferior colliculus to Heschl's gyrus (BA41/42). (Mnemonic: Lateral = Light, Medial = Music.)
why.uz: T2 va O3 plastinkalarida pulvinar ostida ikkita tizzasimon tana (metatalamus) joylashgan: 6 qavatli lateral tizzasimon yadro (LGN) ko'rishni V1 (BA17) po'stlog'iga, medial tizzasimon tana (MGN) esa pastki do'nglikdan kelgan eshitish signalini Geshl pushtasiga (BA41/42) uzatadi.

q.en: Which is the largest nucleus of the human thalamus, overhanging the geniculate bodies posteriorly and serving as a higher-order visual attention and salience relay?
q.uz: Inson talamusining eng yirik yadrosi bo'lib, orqa tomonda tizzasimon tanalar ustiga osilib turgan hamda ko'rish diqqati va ahamiyatlilik (salience) uchun javobgar bo'g'in qaysi?

options.en: Pulvinar nucleus
options.uz: Pulvinar (yostiqcha) yadrosi

options.en: Anterior nuclear group
options.uz: Oldingi yadrolar guruhi

options.en: Parafascicular nucleus
options.uz: Parafassikulyar yadro

options.en: Mediodorsal thalamic nucleus
options.uz: Mediodorsal talamik yadro

why.en: The pulvinar (Latin for 'cushion') forms the large posterior pole of the thalamus (plates T2 and O3); it connects reciprocally with the superior colliculus and parieto-temporo-occipital association cortex to direct visual attention (lesions cause contralateral visual neglect-like inattention).
why.uz: Pulvinar (lotincha 'yostiqcha') talamusning eng yirik orqa yadrosi bo'lib (T2 va O3 plastinkalari), yuqori do'nglik va tepa-chakka-ensa assotsiativ po'stlog'i orasida ko'rish diqqatini boshqaradi (zararlanishi qarama-qarshi ko'rish e'tiborsizligini beradi).

q.en: Which hypothalamic nucleus sits directly on top of the optic chiasm (plate G1) and acts as the body's master circadian clock?
q.uz: Gipotalamusning qaysi yadrosi bevosita ko'rish kesishmasi ustida (G1 plastinkasi) joylashgan bo'lib, organizmning bosh sirkad (sutkalik) soati vazifasini bajaradi?

options.en: Suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN)
options.uz: Suprachiazmatik yadro (SCN)

options.en: Mammillary body complex (MB)
options.uz: So'rg'ichsimon tana majmuasi (MB)

options.en: Ventromedial hypothalamic nucleus (VMN)
options.uz: Ventromedial gipotalamik yadro (VMN)

options.en: Posterior hypothalamic nucleus (PHN)
options.uz: Orqa gipotalamik yadro (PHN)

why.en: The suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) sits immediately above the optic chiasm in the supraoptic zone (plate G1). It receives direct retinal light input via the retinohypothalamic tract (melanopsin ganglion cells) to synchronize sleep–wake, temperature, cortisol, and pineal melatonin rhythms.
why.uz: Suprachiazmatik yadro (SCN) G1 va G4 plastinkalarida ko'rish kesishmasining bevosita ustida joylashgan bosh sirkad soatdir; u to'r pardadan retinogipotalamik trakt orqali yorug'lik signalini olib, uyqu-uyg'oqlik, harorat va melatonin ritmlarini boshqaradi.

sources.title: Saper & Lowell 2014, Curr Biol — The hypothalamus

q.en: Which two hypothalamic nuclei contain magnocellular neurosecretory neurons that synthesize vasopressin (ADH) and oxytocin and send their axons down the pituitary stalk to the posterior pituitary?
q.uz: Gipotalamusning qaysi ikki yadrosidagi magnotsellyulyar neyronlar vazopressin (ADG) hamda oksitotsin ishlab chiqarib, o'z aksonlari orqali orqa gipofizga (neyrogipofizga) yuboradi?

options.en: Supraoptic nucleus (SON) and paraventricular nucleus (PVN)
options.uz: Supraoptik yadro (SON) va paraventrikulyar yadro (PVN)

options.en: Ventromedial nucleus (VMN) and dorsomedial nucleus (DMN)
options.uz: Ventromedial yadro (VMN) va dorsomedial yadro (DMN)

options.en: Medial preoptic nucleus (MPO) and mammillary body (MB)
options.uz: Medial preoptik yadro (MPO) va so'rg'ichsimon tana (MB)

options.en: Suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) and posterior hypothalamic nucleus
options.uz: Suprachiazmatik yadro (SCN) va orqa gipotalamik yadro

why.en: Magnocellular neurons in the supraoptic nucleus (SON, straddling the optic tract, mainly ADH) and paraventricular nucleus (PVN, beside the 3rd ventricle, oxytocin and ADH) project directly through the supraoptico-hypophyseal tract to the posterior pituitary. Destruction causes central diabetes insipidus.
why.uz: Supraoptik (SON, ko'rish trakti ustida) va paraventrikulyar (PVN, III qorincha devori yonida) yadrolarning yirik (magnotsellyulyar) neyronlari vazopressin (ADG) va oksitotsin sintezlab, gipofiz oyoqchasi orqali orqa gipofizga uzatadi; ularning zararlanishi markaziy qandsiz diabetga olib keladi.

sources.title: Saper & Lowell 2014, Curr Biol — The hypothalamus

q.en: On the mid-sagittal hypothalamic map (plate G4), what are the four rostro-caudal zones of the hypothalamus from anterior to posterior?
q.uz: Gipotalamusning o'rta sagittal xaritasida (G4 plastinkasi) oldindan orqaga joylashgan to'rtta zonasi qaysilar?

options.en: Preoptic → Supraoptic → Tuberal → Mammillary
options.uz: Preoptik → Supraoptik → Tuberal → Mamillyar

options.en: Supraoptic → Preoptic → Mammillary → Tuberal
options.uz: Supraoptik → Preoptik → Mamillyar → Tuberal

options.en: Periventricular → Medial → Intermediate → Lateral
options.uz: Periventrikulyar → Medial → Oraliq → Lateral

options.en: Anterior → Ventral → Pulvinar → Metathalamic
options.uz: Oldingi → Ventral → Pulvinar → Metatalamik

why.en: From front to back (plate G4), the hypothalamus is organized into four rostro-caudal zones: (1) Preoptic (medial preoptic nucleus behind the lamina terminalis), (2) Supraoptic/anterior (SCN, SON, PVN, AHN above the optic chiasm), (3) Tuberal (DMN, VMN, arcuate above the median eminence), and (4) Mammillary/posterior (mammillary bodies and posterior hypothalamic nucleus).
why.uz: G4 plastinkasida gipotalamus oldindan orqaga to'rtta zonaga bo'linadi: (1) Preoptik (lamina terminalis ortida), (2) Supraoptik/oldingi (ko'rish kesishmasi ustida: SCN, SON, PVN, AHN), (3) Tuberal (median bo'rtma ustida: DMN, VMN, yoysimon yadro) va (4) Mamillyar/orqa (so'rg'ichsimon tanalar va orqa gipotalamik yadro).

q.en: How do the anterior (preoptic/supraoptic) and posterior hypothalamic regions oppose each other in thermoregulation?
q.uz: Tana haroratini boshqarishda oldingi (preoptik/supraoptik) va orqa gipotalamus yadrolari bir-biriga qanday qarama-qarshi vazifani bajaradi?

options.en: Anterior/preoptic drives heat loss (sweating, vasodilation); posterior drives heat conservation (shivering, vasoconstriction)
options.uz: Oldingi/preoptik issiqlik chiqarishni (terlash, tomir kengayishi); orqa esa issiqlik saqlashni (titrash, tomir torayishi) boshqaradi

options.en: Anterior/preoptic drives heat conservation (shivering, vasoconstriction); posterior drives heat loss (sweating, vasodilation)
options.uz: Oldingi/preoptik issiqlik saqlashni (titrash, tomir torayishi); orqa esa issiqlik chiqarishni (terlash, tomir kengayishi) boshqaradi

options.en: Anterior/preoptic sets basal thyroid tone via TRH release; posterior regulates core temperature solely via cutaneous vasodilation
options.uz: Oldingi/preoptik TRH orqali bazal qalqonsimon bez tonusini; orqa esa haroratni faqat teri tomirlarini kengaytirish orqali boshqaradi

options.en: Ventromedial nucleus drives sympathetic heat generation; dorsomedial nucleus drives parasympathetic cooling during fever
options.uz: Ventromedial yadro simpatik issiqlik hosil qilishni; dorsomedial yadro esa isitmada parasimpatik sovitishni ta'minlaydi

why.en: Warm-sensitive neurons in the medial preoptic and anterior hypothalamic nuclei dissipate heat via sweating, cutaneous vasodilation, and parasympathetic tone (lesions cause central hyperthermia). The posterior hypothalamic nucleus conserves and generates heat via vasoconstriction, shivering, and sympathetic tone (lesions cause poikilothermia/hypothermia).
why.uz: Oldingi va medial preoptik yadrolar issiqlik chiqarish (terlash, tomir kengayishi, parasimpatik faollashuv) uchun javobgar bo'lib, zararlansa markaziy gipertermiya yuzaga keladi; orqa gipotalamik yadro esa issiqlikni saqlash (titrash, tomir torayishi, simpatik faollashuv) markazi bo'lib, zararlansa poykilotermiya beradi.

sources.title: Saper & Lowell 2014, Curr Biol — The hypothalamus

q.en: Which two main structures make up the epithalamus at the dorsocaudal roof of the diencephalon (plate O3), and what hormone does its endocrine gland secrete at night?
q.uz: Oraliq miyaning orqa-yuqori qismida (O3 plastinkasi) epitalamusni qaysi ikki asosiy tuzilma hosil qiladi va uning endokrin bezi kechasi qaysi gormonni ajratadi?

options.en: Pineal gland (secreting melatonin) and the paired habenulae
options.uz: Epifiz bezi (melatonin ajratadi) va juft habenula yadrolari

options.en: Neurohypophysis (secreting vasopressin) and the mammillary bodies
options.uz: Neyrogipofiz (vazopressin ajratadi) va so'rg'ichsimon tanalar

options.en: Subthalamic nucleus (motor relay) and the adjacent zona incerta
options.uz: Subtalamik yadro (harakat bo'g'ini) va yonidagi zona incerta

options.en: Median eminence (releasing GnRH) and the subfornical organ
options.uz: Median bo'rtma (GnRH ajratadi) va gumbazosti a'zo (subfornikal organ)

why.en: The epithalamus sits above the posterior commissure at the midbrain–diencephalon junction (plate O3) and consists of the pineal gland (a circumventricular endocrine organ secreting melatonin at night under SCN → PVN → IML → superior cervical ganglion control) and the paired habenulae (which receive the stria medullaris thalami and project via the fasciculus retroflexus to the interpeduncular nucleus and VTA).
why.uz: O3 plastinkasida orqa komissura ustida epitalamusning ikki asosiy tuzilmasi joylashgan: kechasi SCN boshqaruvi ostida melatonin ajratuvchi epifiz (pineal bez) hamda stria medullaris orqali limbik signal oluvchi juft habenula (yuganak).

q.en: How is the ventral lateral (VL) motor thalamus subdivided between basal-ganglia and cerebellar outflow, and which subdivision is the stereotactic target for essential and parkinsonian tremor?
q.uz: Harakat talamusining ventral lateral (VL) yadrosi bazal yadrolar va miyacha chiqishlari o'rtasida qanday bo'lingan va uning qaysi qismi tremorda DBS / fokuslangan ultratovush nishoni hisoblanadi?

options.en: VLa receives pallidal (GPi) outflow; VLp (Vim) receives cerebellar dentate outflow and is the tremor target
options.uz: VLa pallidar (GPi) chiqishni oladi; VLp (Vim) miyacha tishsimon yadro signalini oladi va tremor nishonidir

options.en: VLa receives cerebellar dentate outflow and is the tremor target; VLp (Vim) receives pallidal (GPi) outflow
options.uz: VLa miyacha tishsimon yadro signalini oladi va tremor nishonidir; VLp (Vim) pallidar (GPi) chiqishni oladi

options.en: VLa receives spinothalamic afferents; VLp receives medial lemniscal fibres and is the tremor target
options.uz: VLa spinotalamik tolalarni oladi; VLp medial lemnisk tolalarini qabul qiladi va tremor nishoni hisoblanadi

options.en: Both VLa and VLp receive nigral (SNr) outflow exclusively; the centromedian nucleus is the tremor target
options.uz: VLa va VLp ning ikkalasi ham faqat SNr chiqishini oladi; tremorda esa sentromedian yadro nishonga olinadi

why.en: On plates T2 and B4, basal-ganglia and cerebellar loops converge on the motor thalamus without mixing: GPi and SNr send GABAergic inhibition via the thalamic fasciculus (H1) to VA and VLa (anterior VL), while the contralateral dentate nucleus sends excitatory fibres via the dentato-rubro-thalamic tract to VLp (Hassler's Vim, ventral intermediate nucleus), which projects to M1 (BA4). Vim is the premier DBS and MR-guided focused ultrasound thalamotomy target for essential and parkinsonian tremor.
why.uz: T2 va B4 plastinkalarida ko'rsatilganidek, VL yadroning oldingi qismi (VLa, VA bilan birga) talamik tutam (H1) orqali GPi/SNr tormozlovchi signalini, orqa qismi (VLp = Vim, ventral oraliq yadro) esa dentato-rubro-talamik trakt orqali qarama-qarshi miyacha tishsimon yadrosining qo'zg'atuvchi signalini M1 (BA4) po'stlog'iga uzatadi. Vim — essensial va parkinson tremorida asosiy DBS va fokuslangan ultratovush nishonidir.

q.en: What is the unique neurochemical and connectional feature of the thalamic reticular nucleus, and which rhythm does it generate in sleep and absence epilepsy?
q.uz: Talamusning to'rsimon yadrosi neyromediatori va bog'lanishi jihatidan boshqa talamus yadrolaridan nimasi bilan farq qiladi hamda uyqu va absans epilepsiyasida qanday ritmni boshqaradi?

options.en: A GABAergic shell that does not project to cortex, inhibiting thalamic relay nuclei to drive sleep spindles and 3-Hz absence rhythms
options.uz: Po'stloqqa tola bermaydigan GABAergik qobiq bo'lib, bo'g'in yadrolarini tormozlab uyqu urchuqlari va 3 Gs absans ritmini yuritadi

options.en: A glutamatergic midline nucleus projecting diffusely to prefrontal cortex to drive slow-wave delta sleep and tonic-clonic seizures
options.uz: Prefrontal po'stloqqa diffuz tola beruvchi glutamatergik o'rta chiziq yadrosi bo'lib, delta uyqu va tonik-klonik tutqanoqlarni yuritadi

options.en: A cholinergic intralaminar nucleus projecting to the striatum and hippocampus to drive REM theta rhythms and temporal lobe seizures
options.uz: Striatum va gippokampga tola beruvchi xolinergik intralaminar yadro bo'lib, REM teta ritmi va chakka tutqanoqlarini boshqaradi

options.en: A dopaminergic periventricular shell projecting directly to the basal ganglia to drive beta oscillations and myoclonic jerks
options.uz: Bazal yadrolarga bevosita tola beruvchi dofaminergik periventrikulyar qobiq bo'lib, beta tebranishlar va mioklonik silkinishlarni yuritadi

why.en: On plates T1 and T2, the thalamic reticular nucleus (Rt) forms a thin GABAergic shell between the external medullary lamina and the internal capsule. Unlike all other thalamic nuclei, it sends no axons to the cortex; instead it receives collaterals from thalamocortical and corticothalamic fibres, gates relay nuclei, generates sleep spindles, and acts as the pacemaker for generalized 3-Hz spike-wave absence seizures via T-type Ca²⁺ channels (the target of ethosuximide).
why.uz: T1 va T2 plastinkalarida talamusning to'rsimon yadrosi tashqi medullyar plastinka va ichki kapsula orasida yupqa GABAergik qobiq hosil qiladi. U po'stloqqa emas, talamusning bo'g'in yadrolariga tormozlovchi chiqish berib, diqqat 'darvozasi', uyqu urchuqlari va absans tutqanoqlaridagi 3 Gs cho'qqi-to'lqin ritmini (T-tip Ca²⁺ kanallari — etosuksimid nishoni) boshqaradi.

q.en: Which set accurately lists the four major arterial territories of the thalamus and their primary parent vessels?
q.uz: Talamusning to'rtta asosiy arterial qon ta'minoti havzasi va ularning asosiy manba tomirlari qaysi javobda to'g'ri ko'rsatilgan?

options.en: Tuberothalamic (PCom), paramedian (P1 PCA), inferolateral/thalamogeniculate (P2 PCA), and posterior choroidal (P2 PCA)
options.uz: Tuberotalamik (PCom), paramedian (P1 PCA), inferolateral/talamogenikulyar (P2 PCA) va orqa xorioidal (P2 PCA)

options.en: Recurrent artery of Heubner (ACA), medial lenticulostriate (M1 MCA), anterior choroidal (ICA), and basilar pontine perforators
options.uz: Heubner qaytuvchi arteriyasi (ACA), medial lentikulostriar (M1 MCA), oldingi xorioidal (ICA) va bazilyar ko'prik perforantlari

options.en: Tuberothalamic (M1 MCA), paramedian (ACom), thalamogeniculate (superior cerebellar artery), and anterior choroidal (P1 PCA)
options.uz: Tuberotalamik (M1 MCA), paramedian (ACom), talamogenikulyar (ustki miyacha arteriyasi) va oldingi xorioidal (P1 PCA)

options.en: Lateral lenticulostriate (MCA), anterior spinal (vertebral), posterior inferior cerebellar (PICA), and anterior inferior cerebellar (AICA)
options.uz: Lateral lentikulostriar (MCA), oldingi orqa miya (umurtqa), orqa pastki miyacha (PICA) va oldingi pastki miyacha (AICA)

why.en: On plates T1 and T2, thalamic strokes divide into four classic vascular territories: (1) tuberothalamic/polar from PCom (anterior nuclei, VA, ventral VL); (2) paramedian/thalamoperforating from P1 PCA, including the artery of Percheron (MD, CM/intralaminar); (3) inferolateral/thalamogeniculate from P2 PCA (VPL, VPM, VL); and (4) posterior choroidal from P2 PCA (pulvinar, LGN, LP).
why.uz: T1 va T2 plastinkalarida keltirilganidek, talamus to'rtta arterial havzadan qon oladi: (1) tuberotalamik/qutb (PCom: oldingi yadrolar, VA, ventral VL); (2) paramedian/talamoperforant (P1 PCA, Percheron arteriyasi: MD, CM/intralaminar); (3) inferolateral/talamogenikulyar (P2 PCA: VPL, VPM, VL); va (4) orqa xorioidal (P2 PCA: pulvinar, LGN, LP).

q.en: How are the six layers of the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) organized with respect to eye of origin and magnocellular versus parvocellular streams?
q.uz: Lateral tizzasimon yadroning (LGN) 6 ta qatlami ko'z tomoni (qarama-qarshi va o'sha tomon) hamda magnotsellyulyar va parvotsellyulyar oqimlar bo'yicha qanday taqsimlangan?

options.en: Layers 1, 4, 6 contralateral and 2, 3, 5 ipsilateral; ventral layers 1–2 magnocellular, dorsal layers 3–6 parvocellular
options.uz: 1, 4, 6-qatlamlar qarama-qarshi va 2, 3, 5 o'sha tomon ko'zdan; pastki 1–2 magnotsellyulyar, yuqori 3–6 parvotsellyulyar

options.en: Layers 1, 3, 5 contralateral and 2, 4, 6 ipsilateral; ventral layers 1–2 parvocellular, dorsal layers 3–6 magnocellular
options.uz: 1, 3, 5-qatlamlar qarama-qarshi va 2, 4, 6 o'sha tomon ko'zdan; pastki 1–2 parvotsellyulyar, yuqori 3–6 magnotsellyulyar

options.en: Layers 1, 2, 3 contralateral and 4, 5, 6 ipsilateral; ventral layers 1–4 magnocellular, dorsal layers 5–6 koniocellular
options.uz: 1, 2, 3-qatlamlar qarama-qarshi va 4, 5, 6 o'sha tomon ko'zdan; pastki 1–4 magnotsellyulyar, yuqori 5–6 koniotsellyulyar

options.en: Layers 2, 3, 5 contralateral and 1, 4, 6 ipsilateral; all six layers mix magnocellular and parvocellular retinal inputs
options.uz: 2, 3, 5-qatlamlar qarama-qarshi va 1, 4, 6 o'sha tomon ko'zdan; oltala qatlam ham magnotsellyulyar va parvotsellyulyar aralash

why.en: The LGN has six layers representing the contralateral visual hemifield: crossed nasal-retina fibres end in layers 1, 4, and 6; uncrossed temporal-retina fibres end in layers 2, 3, and 5. Ventral layers 1 and 2 are magnocellular (M-stream, motion and contrast) and dorsal layers 3–6 are parvocellular (P-stream, colour and fine acuity), projecting via the optic radiation to V1 (BA17).
why.uz: Lateral tizzasimon yadro (LGN) 6 qatlamli ko'rish bo'g'inidir: 1, 4, 6-qatlamlar qarama-qarshi ko'zdan (kesishgan burun yarmi), 2, 3, 5-qatlamlar o'sha tomon ko'zdan (kesishmagan chakka yarmi) signal oladi; 1–2-qatlamlar magnotsellyulyar (harakat va kontrast), 3–6-qatlamlar esa parvotsellyulyar (rang va mayda detal) bo'lib, ko'rish radiatsiyasi orqali V1 (BA17) ga boradi.

q.en: In the tuberal and lateral hypothalamus (plates G2 and G4), how do arcuate nucleus neurons respond to leptin and ghrelin, and what are the classic effects of VMN versus LHA lesions?
q.uz: Tuberal va lateral gipotalamusda (G2 va G4 plastinkalari) yoysimon yadro neyronlari leptin va grelinga qanday javob beradi hamda VMN va LHA zararlanishining klassik oqibatlari qanday?

options.en: Leptin excites POMC/CART (satiety) and inhibits NPY/AgRP (ghrelin-driven hunger); VMN lesion causes obesity, LHA lesion causes aphagia
options.uz: Leptin POMC/CART (to'qlik) ni qo'zg'atib, NPY/AgRP (grelinli ochlik) ni tormozlaydi; VMN zararlanishi semizlik, LHA afagiya beradi

options.en: Ghrelin excites POMC/CART (satiety) and inhibits NPY/AgRP (leptin-driven hunger); VMN lesion causes aphagia, LHA lesion causes obesity
options.uz: Grelin POMC/CART (to'qlik) ni qo'zg'atib, NPY/AgRP (leptinli ochlik) ni tormozlaydi; VMN zararlanishi afagiya, LHA semizlik beradi

options.en: Leptin excites NPY/AgRP neurons to stimulate PVN satiety receptors; VMN and LHA lesions both produce severe anorexia and weight loss
options.uz: Leptin PVN to'qlik reseptorlarini faollashtirish uchun NPY/AgRP ni qo'zg'atadi; VMN va LHA zararlanishi ikkalasi ham anoreksiya beradi

options.en: Insulin excites LHA orexin neurons to suppress appetite; VMN lesion causes diabetes insipidus while LHA lesion causes hyperphagia
options.uz: Insulin ishtahani bosish uchun LHA oreksin neyronlarini qo'zg'atadi; VMN zararlanishi qandsiz diabet, LHA esa giperfagiya beradi

why.en: On plates G2 and G4, arcuate POMC/CART (anorexigenic) and NPY/AgRP (orexigenic) neurons sense circulating leptin, insulin, and ghrelin above the median eminence. Leptin and insulin excite POMC/CART (releasing α-MSH onto PVN MC4R → satiety) and inhibit NPY/AgRP (which ghrelin excites to drive LHA orexin/MCH hunger circuits). VMN ('satiety centre') destruction causes hyperphagic obesity; LHA ('hunger centre') destruction causes aphagia, and selective loss of LHA orexin neurons causes narcolepsy with cataplexy.
why.uz: G2 va G4 plastinkalarida ko'rsatilganidek, yoysimon yadrodagi POMC/CART (to'qlik) neyronlari leptin va insulindan qo'zg'alib, PVN dagi MC4R ga α-MSH chiqarish orqali to'qlik beradi; NPY/AgRP (ochlik) neyronlari esa grelindan qo'zg'alib, LHA (oreksin/MCH — 'ochlik markazi') orqali ishtahani oshiradi. VMN ('to'qlik markazi') zararlansa giperfagik semizlik, LHA zararlansa afagiya, LHA oreksin neyronlari yo'qolsa katapleksiyali narkolepsiya kelib chiqadi.

sources.title: Saper & Lowell 2014, Curr Biol — The hypothalamus

q.en: Why does mechanical compression or transection of the pituitary stalk ('stalk effect', plate G2) cause hyperprolactinaemia alongside anterior hypopituitarism?
q.uz: Nima sababdan gipofiz oyoqchasining bosilishi yoki kesilishi ('oyoqcha ta'siri', G2 plastinkasi) oldingi gipopituitarizm bilan bir qatorda giperprolaktinemiyani keltirib chiqaradi?

options.en: It interrupts tuberoinfundibular dopamine from the arcuate nucleus, removing tonic inhibition of lactotrophs
options.uz: Yoysimon yadrodan keluvchi tuberoinfundibulyar dofamin oqimi uzilib, laktotroflarning doimiy tormozlanishi yo'qoladi

options.en: It blocks somatostatin delivery from the periventricular nucleus, disinhibiting prolactin and growth hormone equally
options.uz: Periventrikulyar yadrodan somatostatin kelishi to'xtab, prolaktin va o'sish gormoni ajralishi birdek kuchayadi

options.en: It triggers retrograde leakage of stored prolactin from degenerating magnocellular axons in the posterior pituitary
options.uz: Orqa gipofizdagi yemirilayotgan magnotsellyulyar aksonlardan zaxiralangan prolaktinning qonga chiqishiga sabab bo'ladi

options.en: It increases TRH concentration in the hypophyseal portal veins by obstructing venous outflow from the median eminence
options.uz: Median bo'rtmadan venoz oqimni to'sib qo'yib, gipofizar portal venalarda TRH konsentratsiyasini keskin oshiradi

why.en: Unlike all other anterior pituitary hormones (which require hypothalamic releasing hormones), prolactin is under tonic inhibition by dopamine released from arcuate (tuberoinfundibular) neurons into the hypophyseal portal vessels at the median eminence. Stalk compression cuts off dopamine delivery, causing mild-to-moderate hyperprolactinaemia ('stalk effect', typically < 100 ng/mL).
why.uz: Oldingi gipofizning boshqa gormonlaridan farqli ravishda, prolaktin yoysimon yadrodan median bo'rtma portal kapillyarlariga chiqadigan tuberoinfundibulyar dofamin tomonidan doimiy tormozlab turiladi. Oyoqcha bosilsa yoki kesilsa, dofamin yetib bormaydi va prolaktin miqdori oshadi ('oyoqcha ta'siri', odatda < 100 ng/ml).

q.en: What are the main connections and clinical significance of the centromedian (CM) and parafascicular (Pf) intralaminar nuclei inside the internal medullary lamina (plates T1 and T2)?
q.uz: Talamusning ichki medullyar plastinkasi ichida joylashgan sentromedian (CM) va parafassikulyar (Pf) intralaminar yadrolarning asosiy bog'lanishlari hamda klinik ahamiyati qanday (T1 va T2 plastinkalari)?

options.en: Relay GPi, reticular arousal, and affective pain inputs to striatum and diffuse cortex; DBS target for Tourette syndrome and generalized epilepsy
options.uz: GPi, retikulyar uyg'oqlik va hissiy og'riq signallarini striatum va po'stloqqa uzatadi; Tourette sindromi va generallashgan epilepsiyada DBS nishoni

options.en: Relay retinal ganglion and superior collicular inputs to parieto-occipital association cortex; lesion causes contralateral visual hemineglect
options.uz: To'r parda va yuqori do'nglik signallarini tepa-ensa assotsiativ po'stlog'iga uzatadi; zararlanishi qarama-qarshi ko'rish e'tiborsizligini beradi

options.en: Relay mammillothalamic and hippocampal inputs directly to the cingulate gyrus within the Papez circuit; lesion causes Korsakoff amnesia
options.uz: Papez halqasida mamillotalamik va gippokamp signallarini belbog' pushtasiga uzatadi; zararlanishi Korsakov amneziyasini keltirib chiqaradi

options.en: Relay trigeminal and spinothalamic discriminative touch inputs to primary somatosensory cortex (S1); lesion causes Dejerine–Roussy pain
options.uz: Trigeminal va spinotalamik nozik teginish signallarini birlamchi somatosensor po'stloqqa (S1) uzatadi; zararlanishi Dejerine–Roussy og'rig'ini beradi

why.en: On plates T1 and T2, the centromedian (CM) and parafascicular (Pf) nuclei are the largest intralaminar nuclei inside the internal medullary lamina (split by the fasciculus retroflexus). They relay reticular activating system arousal, paleospinothalamic affective pain, and GPi signals to the striatum (CM → putamen, Pf → caudate) and diffuse cortex; CM–Pf DBS is used for refractory Tourette syndrome and generalized (e.g. Lennox–Gastaut) epilepsy.
why.uz: T1 va T2 plastinkalarida CM va Pf ichki medullyar plastinka ichidagi eng yirik intralaminar yadrolardir. Ular GPi, retikulyar formatsiya va paleospinotalamik traktdan signal olib, striatumga (CM → putamen, Pf → kaudat) hamda po'stloqqa diffuz chiqish beradi (uyg'oqlik va og'riqning sekin hissiy yo'li); CM–Pf Tourette sindromi va generallashgan epilepsiyada DBS nishoni sifatida ishlatiladi.

q.en: Which pathway allows the suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) to control nocturnal pineal melatonin secretion, and which tract connects the habenula to the midbrain?
q.uz: Suprachiazmatik yadro (SCN) kechasi epifizdan melatonin ajralishini qaysi yo'l orqali boshqaradi va habenulani o'rta miya bilan qaysi trakt bog'laydi?

options.en: SCN → PVN → spinal IML (T1–T2) → superior cervical ganglion → pineal; habenula projects via fasciculus retroflexus
options.uz: SCN → PVN → orqa miya IML (T1–T2) → yuqori bo'yin simpatik tuguni → epifiz; habenula fasciculus retroflexus orqali chiqadi

options.en: SCN → posterior commissure → Edinger–Westphal nucleus → ciliary ganglion → pineal; habenula projects via mammillothalamic tract
options.uz: SCN → orqa komissura → Edinger–Westphal yadrosi → kiprik tuguni → epifiz; habenula mamillotalamik trakt orqali chiqadi

options.en: SCN → arcuate nucleus → hypophyseal portal veins → posterior pituitary → pineal; habenula projects via stria terminalis
options.uz: SCN → yoysimon yadro → gipofizar portal venalar → orqa gipofiz → epifiz; habenula stria terminalis orqali chiqadi

options.en: SCN → dorsal motor nucleus of vagus → otic parasympathetic ganglion → pineal; habenula projects via medial forebrain bundle
options.uz: SCN → adashgan nerv dorsal yadrosi → quloq parasimpatik tuguni → epifiz; habenula medial old miya tutami orqali chiqadi

why.en: Light suppresses nocturnal pineal melatonin via the multi-synaptic sympathetic chain: retina → retinohypothalamic tract → SCN → PVN → descending autonomic fibres to the spinal intermediolateral cell column (IML, T1–T2) → superior cervical sympathetic ganglion → postganglionic noradrenergic fibres to the pineal gland. Adjacent to the pineal, the habenula receives limbic and pallidal input via the stria medullaris thalami and projects via the fasciculus retroflexus (of Meynert) to the interpeduncular nucleus, VTA, and raphe ('anti-reward' signal).
why.uz: Epifiz kechasi ko'p bo'g'inli simpatik zanjir orqali melatonin ajratadi: to'r parda → retinogipotalamik trakt → SCN → PVN → orqa miya IML (T1–T2) → yuqori bo'yin simpatik tuguni → epifiz. Yonidagi habenula esa stria medullaris orqali limbik signal olib, fasciculus retroflexus orqali oyoqchalararo yadro, VTA va raphega 'anti-mukofot' signallarini yuboradi.

sources.title: Saper & Lowell 2014, Curr Biol — The hypothalamus

q.en: How do the visual field defects caused by optic chiasm compression (plate G1) differ from those caused by a lesion of the left optic tract (plate G2/G3) or left LGN (plate T2)?
q.uz: Ko'rish kesishmasi bosilganda (G1 plastinkasi) yuzaga keladigan ko'rish maydoni nuqsoni chap ko'rish trakti (G2/G3) yoki chap LGN (T2) zararlanishidan qanday farq qiladi?

options.en: Optic chiasm compression causes bitemporal hemianopia; left optic tract or left LGN lesion causes right homonymous hemianopia
options.uz: Ko'rish kesishmasi bosilishi bitemporal gemianopiya beradi; chap ko'rish trakti yoki chap LGN zararlanishi o'ng gomonim gemianopiya beradi

options.en: Optic chiasm compression causes binasal hemianopia; left optic tract or left LGN lesion causes left ipsilateral homonymous hemianopia
options.uz: Ko'rish kesishmasi bosilishi binazal gemianopiya beradi; chap ko'rish trakti yoki chap LGN zararlanishi chap ipsilateral gomonim gemianopiya beradi

options.en: Optic chiasm compression causes monocular blindness of one eye; left optic tract or left LGN lesion causes bitemporal hemianopia
options.uz: Ko'rish kesishmasi bosilishi bitta ko'zning to'liq ko'rligini beradi; chap ko'rish trakti yoki chap LGN zararlanishi bitemporal gemianopiya beradi

options.en: Optic chiasm compression causes right homonymous hemianopia; left optic tract or left LGN lesion causes vertical gaze palsy with intact fields
options.uz: Ko'rish kesishmasi bosilishi o'ng gomonim gemianopiya beradi; chap ko'rish trakti yoki chap LGN zararlanishi esa ko'rish maydoni saqlangan vertikal falaj beradi

why.en: In the optic chiasm (plate G1), crossing nasal-retina fibres (carrying the temporal visual fields of both eyes) decussate: compression from below by a pituitary macroadenoma causes bitemporal superior quadrantanopia progressing to bitemporal hemianopia, whereas compression from above by a craniopharyngioma hits the inferior temporal quadrants first. Behind the chiasm, each optic tract and LGN carries fibres from both eyes representing the contralateral visual hemifield, so a left-sided lesion causes right homonymous hemianopia.
why.uz: Ko'rish kesishmasida (G1 plastinkasi) to'r pardaning burun yarmi tolalari (ikkala ko'zning chakka ko'rish maydonlari) kesishadi: pastdan o'suvchi gipofiz makroadenomasi avval yuqori kvadrantlarni, yuqoridan bosuvchi kraniofaringioma esa avval pastki kvadrantlarni zararlab, bitemporal gemianopiya beradi. Kesishmadan keyingi chap ko'rish trakti va chap LGN zararlanishi esa qarama-qarshi (o'ng) gomonim gemianopiyani keltirib chiqaradi.

q.en: A child presents with brief episodes of unprovoked mechanical laughter (gelastic seizures) and central precocious puberty. MRI at the tuberal hypothalamic level (plate G2) reveals a non-enhancing sessile mass attached to the third-ventricle floor between the infundibulum and mammillary bodies. What is this lesion?
q.uz: Yosh bolada sababsiz xurujsimon mexanik kulgi (gelastik tutqanoqlar) va markaziy erta jinsiy yetilish aniqlandi. Tuberal gipotalamus darajasidagi MRTda (G2 plastinkasi) voronka bilan so'rg'ichsimon tanalar orasida III qorincha tubiga yopishgan kontrast olmaydigan hosila topildi. Bu qanday hosila?

options.en: Hypothalamic hamartoma of the tuber cinereum
options.uz: Kulrang do'mboqning (tuber cinereum) gipotalamik gamartomasi

options.en: Colloid cyst of the anterosuperior foramen of Monro
options.uz: Monro teshigi old-yuqori qismining kolloid kistasi

options.en: Suprasellar craniopharyngioma of Rathke's pouch remnants
options.uz: Ratke cho'ntagi qoldiqlaridan o'sgan suprasellyar kraniofaringioma

options.en: Pineoblastoma of the dorsocaudal epithalamic roof
options.uz: Epitalamus orqa-yuqori tomining pineoblastomasi

why.en: At the tuberal level (plate G2), a hypothalamic hamartoma arising from the tuber cinereum classically presents in childhood with gelastic (laughing) seizures and central precocious puberty (from premature pulsatile GnRH activation). Because it consists of heterotopic mature neurons and glia, it is non-enhancing on MRI and is treated by stereotactic laser interstitial thermal therapy (LITT) or endoscopic disconnection.
why.uz: Tuberal darajada (G2 plastinkasi) tuber cinereum (kulrang do'mboq) sohasidan rivojlanuvchi gipotalamik gamartoma klassik ravishda gelastik (kulgili) tutqanoqlar va markaziy erta jinsiy yetilish (GnRH erta pulsatsion faollashuvi) belgilari bilan kechadi; MRTda kontrast yutmaydi.

q.en: A 63-year-old patient develops sudden total loss of pain, temperature, touch, vibration, and position sense over the entire right face and right body without motor weakness. Four weeks later, excruciating burning pain and allodynia emerge on the right side. On coronal thalamic anatomy (plate T1), which nuclei and vascular territory are responsible?
q.uz: 63 yoshli bemorda harakat kuchsizligi bo'lmagan holda to'satdan yuzning o'ng yarmi va tananing butun o'ng tomonida barcha sezgi turlari yo'qoldi. To'rt haftadan so'ng o'ng tomonda chidab bo'lmas achishtiruvchi markaziy og'riq (allodiniya) paydo bo'ldi. Talamusning koronal anatomiyasiga (T1 plastinkasi) ko'ra, qaysi yadrolar va arteriya havzasi zararlangan?

options.en: Left VPL and VPM thalamic nuclei — inferolateral (thalamogeniculate, P2 PCA) infarct (Dejerine–Roussy syndrome)
options.uz: Chap talamusning VPL va VPM yadrolari — inferolateral (talamogenikulyar, P2 PCA) infarkti (Dejerine–Roussy sindromi)

options.en: Left posterior limb of the internal capsule — lateral lenticulostriate (M1 MCA) lacunar infarct (pure motor stroke)
options.uz: Chap ichki kapsula orqa oyog'i — lateral lentikulostriar (M1 MCA) lakunar infarkti (sof harakat insulti)

options.en: Left dorsolateral medulla — posterior inferior cerebellar artery (PICA) infarct (Wallenberg lateral medullary syndrome)
options.uz: Chap dorsolateral uzunchoq miya — orqa pastki miyacha arteriyasi (PICA) infarkti (Wallenberg lateral medullyar sindromi)

options.en: Left postcentral gyrus (S1) — distal anterior cerebral artery (ACA) cortical infarct (isolated crural astereognosis)
options.uz: Chap orqa markaziy pushta (S1) — distal oldingi miya arteriyasi (ACA) po'stloq infarkti (yakka oyoq astereognozi)

why.en: On plate T1, all ascending somatosensory pathways from the right body (DCML and spinothalamic tract → left VPL) and right face (trigeminal lemniscus → left VPM) converge in the left ventral posterior thalamus, supplied by the inferolateral (thalamogeniculate) branches of the P2 PCA. Infarction causes contralateral hemianaesthesia of face and body without weakness ('pure sensory stroke'), and weeks later can evolve into Dejerine–Roussy central thalamic pain syndrome.
why.uz: T1 plastinkasida o'ng tana (DCML va spinotalamik trakt → chap VPL) hamda o'ng yuzdan (trigeminal lemnisk → chap VPM) keluvchi barcha sezgi yo'llari chap talamusning ventral orqa yadrolarida uchrashadi. P2 PCA ning talamogenikulyar shoxlari tiqilganda falajliksiz o'ng yuz va tanada barcha sezgilar yo'qoladi ('sof sezgi insulti'), bir necha haftadan so'ng esa Dejerine–Roussy markaziy talamik og'riq sindromi rivojlanadi.

q.en: A 58-year-old woman is found stuporous with a complete vertical gaze palsy, and later shows severe anterograde amnesia and profound apathy. DWI MRI (plates T1 and O3) reveals symmetric paramedian infarcts in BOTH medial thalami extending into the rostral midbrain tegmentum. Occlusion of which vascular variant explains this bilateral infarct from a single embolus?
q.uz: 58 yoshli ayol stupor va to'liq vertikal qarash falaji bilan topildi, keyinchalik og'ir anterograd amneziya va chuqur apatiya aniqlandi. DWI MRTda (T1 va O3 plastinkalari) IKKALA medial talamusda va rostral o'rta miya tegmentumida simmetrik paramedian infarkt ko'rindi. Bitta embol qaysi tomir variantini berkitib qo'ygan?

options.en: Artery of Percheron — a single unpaired P1 PCA paramedian trunk supplying both medial thalami and rostral midbrain
options.uz: Percheron arteriyasi — ikkala medial talamus va rostral o'rta miyani ta'minlovchi yagona P1 PCA paramedian shoxi

options.en: Recurrent artery of Heubner — an unpaired A1/A2 ACA trunk supplying both anterior thalamic poles and septal nuclei
options.uz: Heubner qaytuvchi arteriyasi — ikkala oldingi talamus qutbi va septal yadrolarni ta'minlovchi A1/A2 ACA shoxi

options.en: Anterior choroidal artery — a distal ICA trunk supplying both lateral geniculate bodies and retrolenticular capsules
options.uz: Oldingi xorioidal arteriya — ikkala lateral tizzasimon tana va retrolentikulyar kapsulani ta'minlovchi ICA shoxi

options.en: Posterior medial choroidal artery — a P2 PCA trunk supplying both pulvinars and the superior collicular tectum
options.uz: Orqa medial xorioidal arteriya — ikkala pulvinar va yuqori do'nglik tomini ta'minlovchi P2 PCA shoxi

why.en: When the paramedian thalamoperforating arteries arise as a single common trunk from one P1 segment of the PCA — the artery of Percheron (plates T1 and O3) — its occlusion produces bilateral paramedian thalamic infarction (mediodorsal MD and intralaminar CM/Pf nuclei → coma/hypersomnolence, apathy, amnesia) often combined with rostral midbrain infarction (riMLF and interstitial nucleus of Cajal → vertical gaze palsy): the classic Percheron triad.
why.uz: T1 va O3 plastinkalarida ko'rsatilganidek, ikkala paramedian talamoperforant arteriya bitta P1 PCA segmentidan yagona o'zak — Percheron arteriyasi bo'lib chiqqanda, uning tiqilishi ikki tomonlama paramedian talamus (MD va intralaminar CM/Pf → koma/gipersomnoliya, amneziya, apatiya) hamda rostral o'rta miya (riMLF va Cajal yadrosi → vertikal qarash falaji) infarktini keltirib chiqaradi.

q.en: A 24-year-old patient undergoes resection of a suprasellar craniopharyngioma compressing the optic chiasm from above (plate G1). Which visual field deficit appeared first preoperatively, and what is the sequence of the classic postoperative 'triphasic water-balance response'?
q.uz: 24 yoshli bemorda ko'rish kesishmasini yuqoridan bosib turgan suprasellyar kraniofaringioma olib tashlandi (G1 plastinkasi). Operatsiyadan oldin qaysi ko'rish maydoni nuqsoni birinchi paydo bo'lgan va operatsiyadan keyingi klassik 'uch fazali suv almashinuvi javobi' qanday ketma-ketlikda kechadi?

options.en: Bitemporal inferior quadrantanopia first; then acute central DI → transient SIADH/hyponatraemia → permanent central DI
options.uz: Avval bitemporal pastki kvadrantanopiya; so'ngra o'tkir markaziy DI → vaqtinchalik SIADH/giponatriyemiya → doimiy markaziy DI

options.en: Bitemporal superior quadrantanopia first; then transient SIADH/hyponatraemia → acute central DI → spontaneous normalization
options.uz: Avval bitemporal yuqori kvadrantanopiya; so'ngra vaqtinchalik SIADH/giponatriyemiya → o'tkir markaziy DI → o'z-o'zidan tiklanish

options.en: Right homonymous hemianopia with macular sparing; then acute nephrogenic DI → secondary hyperaldosteronism → permanent SIADH
options.uz: Makula saqlangan o'ng gomonim gemianopiya; so'ngra o'tkir nefrogen DI → ikkilamchi giperaldosteronizm → doimiy SIADH

options.en: Binasal inferior quadrantanopia first; then cerebral salt wasting → hyperprolactinaemia → desmopressin-resistant polyuria
options.uz: Avval binazal pastki kvadrantanopiya; so'ngra serebral tuz yo'qotish → giperprolaktinemiya → desmopressinga chidamli poliuriya

why.en: On plate G1, a pituitary macroadenoma compresses the optic chiasm from below (inferior nasal fibres → bitemporal superior quadrantanopia first), whereas a craniopharyngioma compresses from above (superior nasal fibres → bitemporal inferior quadrantanopia first). High stalk/SON/PVN surgical trauma produces the classic triphasic response: (1) acute central DI from stunned axons (days 1–5), (2) SIADH from uncontrolled leakage of stored ADH out of degenerating neurohypophyseal terminals (days 5–10), and (3) permanent central DI once SON/PVN magnocellular neurons degenerate (responds to desmopressin).
why.uz: G1 plastinkasida ko'rsatilganidek, pastdan o'suvchi gipofiz makroadenomasi avval bitemporal yuqori kvadrantlarni, yuqoridan bosuvchi kraniofaringioma esa avval bitemporal pastki kvadrantlarni zararlaydi. SON/PVN va yuqori oyoqcha jarohatida operatsiyadan so'ng uch fazali javob kuzatiladi: 1) o'tkir markaziy qandsiz diabet (aksonlar shoki) → 2) SIADH (yemirilayotgan nerv oxirlaridan tayyor ADG chiqib ketishi) → 3) doimiy markaziy qandsiz diabet (desmopressinga javob beradi).

q.en: A 19-year-old student develops irresistible daytime sleep attacks, sudden emotion-triggered loss of muscle tone (cataplexy) with preserved consciousness, hypnagogic hallucinations, and sleep paralysis, with CSF neuropeptide < 110 pg/mL. Loss of which hypothalamic neurons (plates G1–G3) causes this disorder?
q.uz: 19 yoshli talabada kunduzgi chidab bo'lmas uyqu xurujlari, emotsiyadan keyingi mushak tonusi yo'qolishi (katapleksiya), gipnagogik gallyutsinatsiyalar va uyqu falaji paydo bo'ldi, likvorda neyropeptid < 110 pg/ml. Gipotalamusning qaysi neyronlari yo'qolishi (G1–G3 plastinkalari) bunga sabab bo'ladi?

options.en: Orexin (hypocretin) neurons of the lateral hypothalamic area (LHA) — narcolepsy type 1
options.uz: Lateral gipotalamik sohadagi (LHA) oreksin (gipokretin) neyronlari — 1-tip narkolepsiya

options.en: Magnocellular vasopressin neurons of the supraoptic nucleus (SON) — central diabetes insipidus
options.uz: Supraoptik yadrodagi (SON) magnotsellyulyar vazopressin neyronlari — markaziy qandsiz diabet

options.en: Tuberoinfundibular dopamine neurons of the arcuate nucleus — stalk-effect hyperprolactinaemia
options.uz: Yoysimon yadrodagi tuberoinfundibulyar dofamin neyronlari — oyoqcha ta'siri giperprolaktinemiyasi

options.en: Histaminergic arousal neurons of the tuberomammillary nucleus — fatal familial insomnia
options.uz: Tuberomamillyar yadrodagi gistaminergik uyg'oqlik neyronlari — oilaviy halokatli uyqusizlik

why.en: The lateral hypothalamic area (LHA, plates G1–G4), lateral to the fornix column and traversed by the medial forebrain bundle, houses the brain's sole orexin (hypocretin) neurons, which stabilize wakefulness and suppress inappropriate REM-sleep atonia intrusions via projections to the locus coeruleus, raphe, tuberomammillary nucleus, and pontine reticular formation. Autoimmune loss of LHA orexin neurons causes narcolepsy type 1 (with cataplexy).
why.uz: G1–G4 plastinkalarida fornix ustunidan lateralda joylashgan lateral gipotalamik sohada (LHA) oreksin (gipokretin) neyronlari yotadi; ular uyg'oqlikni barqaror ushlab turadi va REM-uyqu atoniyasi uyg'oq paytda qo'shilib ketishining oldini oladi. LHA dagi oreksin neyronlarining autoimmun yo'qolishi 1-tip (katapleksiyali) narkolepsiyani keltirib chiqaradi.

sources.title: Saper & Lowell 2014, Curr Biol — The hypothalamus

q.en: A 57-year-old right-handed man presents with acute disorientation, severe anterograde verbal amnesia, apathy, and transcortical motor-like anomia without hemiparesis or primary sensory loss. MRI (plates B5 and T2) shows an isolated infarct of the left anterior/anteromedial thalamus (anterior nuclei, VA, ventral VL, and mammillothalamic tract termination). Occlusion of which artery caused this syndrome?
q.uz: 57 yoshli o'ng qo'lli bemorda falajlik va birlamchi sezgi yo'qolishi bo'lmagan holda to'satdan vaqt-makonda mo'ljal yo'qolishi, og'ir anterograd amneziya, apatiya va so'z topish qiyinligi rivojlandi. MRTda (B5 va T2 plastinkalari) chap talamusning oldingi qutbi (oldingi yadrolar, VA, ventral VL va mamillotalamik trakt tugash joyi) infarkti aniqlandi. Qaysi arteriya tiqilishi ushbu sindromni chaqirgan?

options.en: Left tuberothalamic (polar) artery arising from the posterior communicating artery (PCom)
options.uz: Orqa biriktiruvchi arteriyadan (PCom) chiquvchi chap tuberotalamik (qutb) arteriya

options.en: Left posterior choroidal artery arising from the P2 segment of the posterior cerebral artery
options.uz: Orqa miya arteriyasi P2 segmentidan chiquvchi chap orqa xorioidal arteriya

options.en: Left thalamogeniculate (inferolateral) artery arising from the P2 segment of the PCA
options.uz: Orqa miya arteriyasi P2 segmentidan chiquvchi chap talamogenikulyar arteriya

options.en: Left paramedian thalamoperforating artery arising from the P1 segment of the PCA
options.uz: Orqa miya arteriyasi P1 segmentidan chiquvchi chap paramedian talamoperforant arteriya

why.en: On plates T1, T2, and B3, the tuberothalamic (polar / premammillary) branch of the posterior communicating artery supplies the anterior thalamic nuclei, the mammillothalamic tract termination, VA, ventral VL, and the rostral pole of MD. Infarction disconnects both the Papez circuit (mammillothalamic tract → anterior nucleus → amnesia) and anterior thalamic–prefrontal projections (VA/MD → apathy, executive dysfunction, thalamic aphasia/anomia on the left) while sparing VPL/VPM and the internal capsule.
why.uz: T1, T2 va B3 plastinkalarida ko'rsatilganidek, orqa biriktiruvchi arteriyadan (PCom) chiquvchi tuberotalamik (qutb) arteriya talamusning oldingi yadrolarini, mamillotalamik trakt tugash joyini, VA va MD ning oldingi qutbini ta'minlaydi. Uning infarkti VPL/VPM va ichki kapsulani chetlab o'tib, Papez halqasi uzilishi hisobiga o'tkir amneziya, apatiya va talamik nutq buzilishini beradi.
